author: BustyBista
body:
Hey guys! I'm here with another LFT. SO basically I'll start off with basically describing myself. I am calm during scrims. I can ninja bridge. In my honest opinion I rate myself 9/10 with swords skills and 7.5/10 with bow skills. My preferred positions are: rusher, skybridger, frontliner, and monument/core defenses (I don't defend CTW). I assure you that if I join your team, I will help you in a positive way. Here are some of my stats from Avicus (They're gonna be bad because I am an OCN player and I play OCN most of the time).

Monuments: 121 (I usually defend monuments or kill farm).

KD: KD doesn't mean shit ;)

Kills: 2,442

OCN Stats:

Wools: 693

Monuments: I rarely play DTM/DTC on OCN but 40

Cores: I rarely play DTM/DTC on OCN but 40

Thank you for reading my LFT.

*Also, can you please not listen to all the devouchers I'm gonna get, it's just that everyone hates me. Half of them barely even know me. If you try me out you'll see that I am the opposite of what they say <3
